message.content: In the conversations recorded, Li Hua expresses admiration for the complex characters in the series Succession, particularly focusing on the intense family dynamics and the intriguing nature of the business wars. During a discussion about the main character Kendall's motivations, Li Hua notes that Kendall's motivations are "so complex" and involves proving himself not just to his father but also to the world. Li Hua also points out the significant pressure Kendall faces due to the family legacy, making it difficult for him to break free from this dynamic. He adds that the series keeps viewers on the edge of their seats due to the intensity and the compelling plot twists surrounding Kendall's journey. Li Hua's appreciation for the character-driven narratives and the evolving storylines suggests a deep engagement with the series.
